purpose: Provisioning trusts Firebase Auth identity and maps domain errors to stable callable errors.
Groups full reps, partial attempts and time by date and keeps compatible form scores in separate series.
Requires canonical association, active Admin and organization, and a current authentication epoch.
Rules combine authentication, verified email, canonical membership, and role. Callables maintain their own server-side checks.
Scoped deterministic key and canonical digest support safe retries and reject conflicting prior data.
